guide.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about EchoTranslate's architecture, API keys, and voice workflows.
guide.aboutContent: EchoTranslate is a high-speed Client-Side Rendered (CSR) speech-to-speech translation web application built with Angular. It captures voice directly in the browser via native WebRTC MediaRecorder APIs and pipes audio through cloud STT, LLM reasoning, and TTS engines with zero server middleware.
guide.quickstartStep1: Connect your API key in Settings (Groq is free and recommended).
guide.quickstartStep2: Select your Source (FROM) and Target (TO) languages.
guide.quickstartStep3: Press and hold the Walkie-Talkie button, speak, and release to translate instantly.
guide.apiSetupGroqStep2: Click 'Create API Key' and copy your key (starts with 'gsk_').
guide.apiSetupGroqStep3: Open Settings in the top bar, select Groq, and paste your key.
guide.apiSetupOpenAIStep1: Visit platform.openai.com/api-keys and generate an API key.
guide.apiSetupOpenAIStep2: Paste the key into the OpenAI tab in Settings.
guide.controlsHold: Hold-to-Talk (Walkie-Talkie): Press and hold the mic button while speaking, release when done.
guide.controlsClick: Click-to-Toggle (Hands-Free): Tap once to start recording, tap again to finish.
guide.controlsWaveform: Real-Time Visualizer: Animated waveform bars bounce dynamically based on your microphone's live decibel volume.
guide.securityContext: Secure Context Enforcement: Microphone access is strictly confined to HTTPS and localhost domains per browser security standards.
guide.securityTeardown: Instant Hardware Release: Audio tracks are immediately stopped (.stop()) upon recording completion, extinguishing the browser mic indicator dot.
